AppUsers.Description: The people who may sign in. There is no sign-up: a proven email address only gets someone in when it is a row here and IsActive. Roles come from this table, never from a token. Added by the effortless-magic-links seed because the project had no table of people of its own.

schema.name: AppUserId
schema.Description: Stable id of the person. The seed uses the lower-cased email address.

schema.name: EmailAddress
schema.Description: The address the person signs in with. Matched case-blind against the email they prove.

schema.name: DisplayName
schema.Description: How the app shows this person.

schema.name: AppRole
schema.Description: What the person may do: a row of AppRoles (admin, member, ...).

schema.name: IsActive
schema.Description: False keeps the row but lets the person in no more, open sessions included.
